faqs.question: What's the difference between Part AB, Part CD and the Full Kit?
faqs.answer: Part AB is the top case — the LCD back cover and screen bezel. Part CD is the bottom case, keyboard tray and touchpad housing. The Full Kit is both parts together at a combined price.

faqs.question: Do I need both parts?
faqs.answer: Only if both are damaged. If just one side is cracked or broken, you only need that part — tell us which on WhatsApp and we'll confirm the price.

faqs.question: Does the casing come with a keyboard or trackpad fitted?
faqs.answer: No — these are bare panels. The trackpad housing is part of Part CD, but the keyboard and trackpad itself transfer over from your existing casing.

faqs.question: Can I fit this myself?
faqs.answer: It involves a full teardown of the laptop, so most customers have it fitted by us. We can talk you through it on WhatsApp if you'd rather do it yourself.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with a casing?
faqs.answer: Every casing here carries a 3-month warranty against manufacturing defects such as cracking or misaligned mounting points.
